The board shows your overall score from Skills: each family counts its hardest achieved rung, weighted by how hard it is, and harder rungs need a passed test. Only ticked sets in finished workouts count; days marked complete or placed past, repeats and your own workouts don’t. Tiers: Beginner, Novice from 75, Intermediate from 200, Advanced from 425, Elite from 650 and World-class from 850.
